prior_coverage:
I read the repo first. The family was swept on 6.9 as content-seo/affiliate-networks (research/colony-sweep/scouts/content-seo--affiliate-networks.md, all 8 searches snippet-grade, nothing rendered) and killed with its group. The group report (research/colony-sweep/groups/content-seo.md:24, 130-137, 151-153) rejected CJ, Awin, impact.com, ClickBank, Digistore24, Rakuten and Skimlinks/Sovrn as multipliers on zero traffic, with Payoneer payability to Israel UNKNOWN (docs/INCOME_PLAN.he.md:96). It rejected Amazon Associates on the rail; the audit downgraded that to payability UNKNOWN but kept the outcome (research/colony-sweep/audits/content-seo.md:113-120). Israeli-vendor programmes are a permanent rejection (docs/REJECTED.md:1100-1103; audit confirmed at audits/content-seo.md:153-158). The AdSense/MFA storefront model is rejected permanently (docs/REJECTED.md:277). hebrew-content was killed (REJECTED.md:1263-1268) and reopens only when il-biz-tools shows 100+ weekly search views (REJECTED.md:1282). Affiliate-link template repos are refused as funnels (research/tiktok/07-ai-money-tooling.md:227). The faceless-YouTube scouts treat affiliate links as a day-1 rail that is worth nothing without traffic (research/faceless-youtube/DIGEST.md:30, :330).

TRAFFIC OUR SURFACES CAN HONESTLY EXPECT: today, zero measured. Nothing is public: il-biz-tools is blocked at build by the missing accessibility contact (products/il-biz-tools/README.md), and the T1 web arm, mcp-il-tools and the Apify Actor are all unlaunched (logs/CHANNEL_LOOP.md §2-3). The public GitHub repo still carries the owner's name until step 7 (research/channel-loop/BOARD-LOOP.md:9 item f), so it cannot carry brand links yet. The only audited comparables are free calculators at ₪200-400/month in total value, and a competitor calculator with 0 impressions over 16 months (groups/content-seo.md:123-125). Apify's base rate is 8.7 users per Actor, with P(≥10 stranger users) ≈ 30% (research/channel-loop/FORECAST.md:24). DISCLOSURE: none is built. No page in the repo carries an affiliate notice; any link we add needs a visible Hebrew and English disclosure line, which the colony can template.

NEW today (github grade unless noted):
(1) Apify's affiliate terms (apify/apify-docs@1fa5620, sources/legal/latest/terms/affiliate-program-terms-and-conditions.md, last updated 15 Sep 2026), §8 'Open Source Fair Share'. Users who sign up for Apify through our open-source Actor's Store page are credited to us automatically. The rate is 20% of their Apify payments for 3 months, then 30%, capped at $2,500 per customer. Payout is PayPal, bank transfer or Wise, in USD, with a $100 monthly minimum; the 3-customer minimum does not apply. FirstPromoter generates the invoices. §6.1 forbids self-referral and promotion inside Apify-owned content. This is the only programme in the family where the venue supplies the visitors, and it pays on a FREE Actor, so it does not wait for the ≥200-user pricing gate.
(2) publish/index.mdx: an Actor counts as open source when 'Hide source files from Actor detail' is unchecked. That is a Console step. isSourceCodeHidden is not in UpdateActorRequest.yaml, but isPublic is, so Store publishing looks API-able. That contradicts the repo's 'one Console click' (products/README.md:7) and should be runner-tested.
(3) Gumroad global affiliates (antiwork/gumroad@f6b82fbe, global_affiliate.rb and help articles 249/333/334): a 10% fixed commission and a 7-day cookie. Only recommendable products qualify (a counted sale), and anyone can make links with no approval. Credits post to the same Balance as sales, so the payout is ILS through owner step 3.
(4) GitHub Sponsors lists Israel as a supported region (github/docs about-github-sponsors.md).
Snippet grade: iCount runs a fixed-terms partner programme (ILS bank transfer after ₪100, existing customers). Morning's refer-a-friend pays a free month of subscription, not cash. PartnerStack pays Israel by Airwallex direct deposit. Wix pays through impact.com wire with a $300 monthly minimum. Hostinger pays by PayPal at $100 or bank at $500, after 3 approved sales.

BOTTOM LINE: except for Apify §8, every candidate here multiplies traffic we do not have. Apify §8 is the only PROMISING one, and its money is tiny.
